name: io.github.fabiendupont/mcp-google-workspace
title: Google Workspace MCP
description: MCP server for Google Workspace with per-project safety policies

packageArguments.name: --services
packageArguments.description: Google services the agent may use (e.g. drive,gmail,calendar,sheets,docs,slides,tasks). Finer control via a policy file: see the repository README.

packageArguments.name: --policy
packageArguments.description: Path to a policy file inside the container. The image ships only policy.example.json, so mount your policy directory read-only (docker -v /path/to/dir:/etc/mcp-google-workspace:ro) and point this at /etc/mcp-google-workspace/policy.json. When set, the policy file takes precedence over --services (the CLI resolves --policy first). Leave unset to run from the --services list.

environmentVariables.name: GWS_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for /mcp and /metrics. Required whenever the server runs in HTTP mode, including the image's default command (--http 0.0.0.0:3000). Ignored in stdio mode. On a trusted, isolated network pass --insecure-no-auth instead.
